title: Trade unions

match.reason: None of the bank points covers trade unions or workers bargaining collectively; they all teach international trade, so no existing point teaches this idea.

draft.title: Trade unions
card: A trade union is a group of workers who join together. One worker has little bargaining power alone, but a group speaks with a stronger voice.
Unions bargain with employers for better pay, conditions and safety at work. Workers choose to join, and members usually pay a fee.
Unions also support members in disputes, for example by giving advice or speaking for a member who thinks they have been treated unfairly.
Many unions cover workers in one industry or job, such as teachers, nurses or electricians. A union acts for its members, not for employers.
draft.remember: A union is workers joining together to bargain and to support members.

a.q: Why do workers join a trade union?
opts: To bargain as a group and to get support in disputes
To set the minimum wage for every worker in Australia
To advise businesses on how to follow workplace law
To run the business and choose who the managers are
a.why: A union gives workers a group voice for bargaining and help in disputes. Setting minimum wages for all workers is not a union's job, and advising businesses is what an employer group does, not a union.
a.clue: Think about what a group can do that one worker alone cannot.

b.q: Kai works at a warehouse in Geelong and is a union member. He thinks his team's safety rules are poor. What can the union do for him?
opts: Bargain with the employer for better safety for the team
Pay the team's wages while the rules are being fixed
Speak for the employer when it deals with the government
Stop the employer from ever changing the rules again
b.why: Unions bargain for better safety and can support members in disputes. The union does not pay wages, and speaking for the employer is a job for an employer group. The union also cannot promise to stop all change.
b.clue: A union acts for its members.

a.best: To bargain as a group and to get support in disputes

b.best: Bargain with the employer for better safety for the team
